summary: Ozanimod carries a warning because it may raise the risk of getting infections, so people need a blood count checked before starting and should not take it if they currently have an active infection [3]. Patients also need to be checked for signs of infection while taking the medicine and for three months after stopping it [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high score of 66 for the liver and a low score of 42 for the heart [M].
